focus: Denmark tax-benefit surface, pilot-bounded to the child and youth benefit (børne- og ungeydelsen): § 1 age-banded amounts and the § 1 a income-based reduction.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Denmark Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: EUROMOD (Denmark systems)
oracles.role: Intended household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Denmark. EUROMOD is the EU tax-benefit microsimulation model (European Commission JRC); its public release ships Denmark policy systems (DK_XXXX) including the child and family benefit instruments, runnable on the EUROMOD engine with per-case household inputs.

availability_check.detail: Not attempted in this pilot. The EUROMOD public release (JRC) is freely downloadable and its Denmark systems carry the child and youth benefit; the EUROMOD-engine per-case runtime is proven from the SOUTHMOD lanes (x86_64 py3.12 venv + euromod pypi package + x64 .NET). Wiring (dk: prefix mapping in axiom-oracles, DK country scope, per-case parity suites against the DK_2026 system, and the input microdata question - the public release ships no Danish microdata, so probes must use synthetic per-case households) is future work. Until wired, dk: outputs remain classified not_comparable and parity tests stay deferred; this pilot's companion tests assert statutory values from the captured text instead.
